title: Recipe
description: A declarative, signable, fully pinnable description of a set of OCI artifacts (ingredients) that together make up a software delivery. See RECIPE-SPEC.md for normative semantics. Rules not expressible in JSON Schema (ingredient name uniqueness, cooked profile, publication-location consistency) are enforced by tooling.

apiVersion.description: Schema version of this document. The only value accepted by this schema revision is 'recipe.tobby.dev/v1alpha1'.

kind.description: Document kind. Always 'Recipe' for this schema.

metadata.description: Identity and metadata of the recipe.

name.description: Recipe name. Must be a valid OCI repository path segment (lowercase alphanumerics with '.', '_', '-' separators). Becomes the last path segment of the cookbook repository on publication.

version.description: Version of the described application (Semantic Versioning 2.0.0). Becomes the OCI tag on publication.

description.description: Human-readable, one-paragraph description of the recipe.

labels.description: Identifying key/value pairs intended for selection and filtering (Kubernetes label syntax; values at most 63 characters).

annotations.description: Non-identifying metadata (provenance URLs, timestamps, tooling data). Keys should be namespaced with a DNS prefix. Keys under 'recipe.tobby.dev/' are reserved by the specification.

ingredients.description: The OCI artifacts this recipe is made of. Ingredient names must be unique within the recipe (enforced by tooling).

ingredient.description: One OCI artifact referenced by the recipe. Kind-specific fields ('platforms', 'vendorDependencies', 'artifactType', 'extract') are only valid for the kinds that define them.

name.description: Ingredient name, unique within the recipe (DNS label). Used in logs, status reports, and reserved annotation keys.

kind.description: Ingredient kind: ContainerImage (runnable image, possibly multi-platform), HelmChart (OCI-stored Helm chart), OCIArtifact (any other OCI artifact, e.g. AI models), FileSet (files packaged as an OCI image, mountable or extractable).

ref.description: Fully qualified source OCI reference WITHOUT tag or digest: '<registry-host>[:<port>]/<repository-path>'. No default registry, no scheme, no credentials.

version.description: Exact OCI tag, or version constraint expression (wildcards '12.x', caret '^1.4.0', tilde '~1.4.2', comparisons '>=2.0.0', conjunctions '>=2.0.0 <3.0.0'). Cooked recipes must use an exact tag (enforced by tooling).

digest.description: Content digest of the artifact's top-level manifest (the image index for multi-platform images). Optional in drafts, required in cooked recipes (enforced by tooling). Registered algorithms: sha256, sha512.

platforms.description: ContainerImage and FileSet only. Platforms required at the destination, as 'os/arch[/variant]'. Unlisted platforms may be omitted from transfer; if absent, all platforms are transferred.

vendorDependencies.description: HelmChart only. When true, chart dependencies are resolved and embedded at cook time, producing a new artifact whose digest is recorded (the upstream digest should be kept in the 'recipe.tobby.dev/upstream-digest.<name>' annotation). Default false: the chart is transferred bit-for-bit and upstream signatures remain verifiable.

artifactType.description: OCIArtifact only. Expected artifact type (media type syntax) of the fetched manifest; when set, a mismatch fails the ingredient. Guards against tag-reuse and repository confusion.

extract.description: FileSet only. Extraction hints for consumers; does not change what is transferred (the image is always copied bit-exact and in full).

paths.description: Slash-separated glob patterns ('*', '**'), relative to the image root, selecting what to materialize on extraction. Absent means the whole root filesystem. Absolute paths and '..' components are forbidden.
